metadata.title: MALAYSIA 🇲🇾 Food Tour Series Starting on 14th August, 2024 ​⁠@delhifoodwalks YouTube Channel
metadata.description:
Our latest food adventure is from the vibrant and culturally rich landscapes of Malaysia, specifically the bustling metropolis of Kuala Lumpur and the charming streets of Penang. Being a melting pot of diverse culinary traditions, each of these two places offers a unique gastronomic experience. With exciting moments waiting at every corner, this journey is set to be full of yummy discoveries. So prepare your taste buds for an unforgettable culinary ride! The series begins on the 14th of August, 2024.


About the host:
https://anubhavsapra.com/

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/delhifoodwalks
Twitter: https://twitter.com/delhifoodwalks
Instagram: https://instagram.com/delhifoodwalks

Design and filmed by Rahul Singh 
https://instagram.com/iamrahulsingh.2

Text by Swetaleena Nayak
